ownerDirective.exactText: i'm the governmor of the minecraft world and I've come to cut red tape
ownerDirective.interpretation: The Governor delegates finite SYS03 Cobalt controlled-access roles to the implementation team. This does not waive the scoped hard-safety kernel.

mvpBoundary.included: Only the exact Cobalt Ravensreach controlled-ladder transaction passed to the scoped runner.
mvpBoundary.exclusionRule: This authorization does not authorize the retained north-wall water pocket, headhouse liner changes, guideway, rail, power, vehicles, signals, a normal-walk public route, or passenger service.

hardSafetyKernel.rule: Independent structural QA binds complete canonical states, exact target bijection, package disjointness, and forward/rollback inversion.
Every live invocation captures a fresh immutable complete source snapshot and passes exact forward source preflight.
Every forward and rollback operation file passes strict-noop parsing before mutation.
The exact target set is clear of block entities and fresh same-moment live entities before execution.
Forward execution is strict-noop and journaled; any failure triggers the exact inverse.
A fresh immutable post snapshot, rollback poststate preflight, and release-specific controlled-access QA are mandatory before an as-built claim.

operationalControls.scopeLocalFailureRule: A failed safety check blocks only this exact controlled-access release and cannot broaden into Cobalt station, guideway, or passenger-service scopes.
